title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Shares Sold by Essex Investment Management Co. LLC
text:

LLC’s investment portfolio, making the stock its 13th biggest position. Essex Investment Management Co. LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $8,783,000 at the end of the most recent reporting period.
